description: List the published versions of a GRADUATED app (level 4), newest first, with the one currently served. Each version carries its network and AI inventory (`inventaire`): the external hosts its SERVER code declares in clear (what the egress membrane lets it reach), each classed `fournisseur_ia` (closed, sourced list of AI model providers), `dropyour` or `autre`. The top-level `inventaire` states its scope (server side, declared in code: not browser calls, not dynamically built hosts), hosts reachable outside the code (vault secrets, linked apps), and, when the served version can reach an AI provider, a short reminder of the owner's own transparency duties (EU AI Act art. 50) — a reminder, not legal advice. Levels 1-3 have no history at all — replace overwrites the blob under the same key — so they return graduated=false and an empty list. If the app's backend cannot be reached you get degraded=true: that means 'unknown', NOT 'nothing published'. With an account token, owned drops need no managementToken.
name: dropyour_list_versions
title: List a drop's versions
